displayName: Set the company logo backplate color on the new tab page.
description:
By default, the new tab page sets the company logo backplate color to the neutralStrokeActive (#cecece) constant.

You can configure this policy with a color hex code to change the company logo backplate color on the new tab page.

If this policy isn't configured, the default neutralStrokeActive (#cecece) color is used as the backplate color.
categoryName: Startup, home page and new tab page
